AGREEMENT OF SALE IN RESPECT OF MOVABLES

DEFINITIONS

In this agreement of sale (hereinafter referred to as "this agreement of sale") the following words and expressions shall have the following meanings:

		1.1	"the assets"		the movable assets listed in annexure "A" hereto which has been initialled by the parties for purposes of identification;

		1.2	"the effective date"	the date of registration of transfer of the property into the name of the purchaser;

1.3		"the parties"	the seller and the purchaser;

1.4	"the property"		Erf  __________________________;

1.5	"the purchaser”		___________________________________________________________

1.6	 "the seller"	___________________________________________________________

2.	PREAMBLE

The seller is the owner of the property and of the assets.

The seller has sold the property to the purchaser who wishes to purchase the assets from the seller.

This agreement constitutes the sale by the seller to the purchaser of the assets.

SALE AND PURCHASE / SPECIAL CONDITION / BENEFIT, RISK AND OWNERSHIP

3.1	Effective from the effective date the seller sells to the purchaser who purchases the assets from the seller.

This agreement is inextricably linked to the sale of the property to the purchaser to the extent that if such sale fails then this agreement will be null and void and of no further force or effect. Should the purchaser take occupation of the property and possession of the assets prior to the effective date, the purchaser may not alter or alienate the assets prior to the effective date and should the sale fail, the movables shall remain on the property for the seller in their original condition.

3.3	Ownership, benefit and risk in respect of the assets shall pass from the seller to the purchaser on the effective date.

PURCHASE PRICE

The purchase price for the assets is the sum of R__________________

(____________________________________________________________ RAND).

PAYMENT OF PURCHASE PRICE

The purchase price referred to in clause 4 above shall be payable in cash to the seller on the effective date, to be secured before the effective date in the same manner referred to in clause 2.3 of the agreement of sale referred to in sub-clause 2.2 above.

6.	NO WARRANTIES, REPRESENTATIONS ETC

	The purchaser hereby agrees that no warranties or representations have been given or made as to the state or condition of the assets which he/she/it takes with all faults and agrees to accept all risks of whatsoever nature.  Furthermore, the assets are sold and purchased "voetstoots" as they now are, with any defects, the purchaser acknowledging that he/she/it has inspected the assets and satisfied himself/herself/itself as to the condition thereof.

7.	INDULGENCES ETC

	Notwithstanding any express or implied provision of this agreement of sale to the contrary, no latitude or extension of time which may be allowed by the seller to the purchaser in respect of any payment provided for herein, or any matter or thing which the purchaser may be bound to perform or observe in terms hereof, shall under any circumstances be deemed to be a waiver of the seller's right at any time without notice to require strict and punctual compliance with each and every provision or term hereof.

8.	SIGNATURE IN COUNTERPARTS

This agreement of sale may be signed in separate counterparts, each of which shall be deemed to be an original and all of which, taken together, shall constitute one and the same agreement. A counterpart of this Offer to Purchase in email form shall be conclusive evidence of the original signature and shall be as effective in law as the counterparts in original form showing the original signatures.

9.	ENTIRE AGREEMENT

	This agreement of sale constitutes the entire agreement between the seller and the purchaser and no amendment or cancellation or substitution hereof or any portion hereof shall be of any force or effect whatsoever unless such amendment or cancellation or substitution is reduced to writing and signed by the seller and the purchaser.

ANNEXURE ‘A’

Movable Inclusions:

	All furniture, including beds & mattresses, side tables, outdoor furniture, pool loungers, sofas, chairs, pedestals, dining table and chairs.

       Soft furnishings, including lamps, cushions, carpets, rugs, mirrors, towels and one set of bed linen / bedding (including pillows, duvets and blankets) per bed.

      All appliances, including toaster, kettle, microwave, fridge/freezer, iron, television etc.

	All kitchen utensils, including crockery, cutlery, glassware, serving dishes, pots & pans and general kitchen items.

       All outdoor equipment including any garden implements, swimming pool cleaning equipment, water tanks etc.

Alternate power systems – invertor and batteries

Movable Exclusions:
